interpretation: This is an execution-resource failure before serialization, not a failed recurrence identity or a mathematical obstruction. No exact baseline H/K result was accepted.

recommended_replacement.definition: Keep the exact 76-entry transfer, four accepted exception censuses, exact D/S source operator and T25 gauge as provenance-bearing leaves. Seal Add, Multiply, derivative, deterministic Hermite primitive/remainder, H(base)=0 normalization and T25 convolution as circuit nodes; do not expand characteristic-zero H/K matrices.
recommended_replacement.execution: Specialize exact leaves first at a requested (q,p), then execute the complete 2x43, orders -3..4 recurrence with sparse 64-bit modular rational/quartic Hermite arithmetic. Reuse the accepted block-1 point evaluator conventions and merge its two circuit entries additively.
recommended_replacement.acceptance: At each of q7 p=3 and p=239/47, replay all 688 recurrence coordinates and 688 basepoint values, then T25 orders 0..2 and target orders -4..2. A second disjoint prime is needed only if required by the existing probabilistic acceptance policy.
recommended_replacement.exactness_contract: The exact object is the provenance-sealed arithmetic circuit; modular images are its evaluator and acceptance evidence, not a modular-oracle-only final result.
recommended_replacement.why_preferred: It performs cancellations and Hermite reduction after finite-field specialization, avoids the observed 36-GiB expanded exact intermediate, and requires neither cross-prime reconstruction of expanded H/K coefficients nor another exact Maple recurrence.
